business_impact: Known scenario: Selected active meters report zero/stale readings because simulated field communication failed.
resolution_summary: Check upstream polling platform, device status, and whether corrected measurement values were posted.

business_impact: Known scenario: A retry creates duplicate meter/timestamp records with different raw_reading_id values.
resolution_summary: Group by meter_id and reading_timestamp; inspect batch retry history.

business_impact: Known scenario: Source feed contains meter IDs missing from meter_master.
resolution_summary: Validate source meter IDs against meter_master and update mapping or reject feed.

business_impact: Known scenario: Valid readings arrive after the normal reporting refresh window.
resolution_summary: Compare event, poll, load, and report refresh timestamps.

business_impact: Known scenario: Meters repeat stale values and quality codes for several hours.
resolution_summary: Check tag freshness, polling logs, and communication status.

business_impact: Known scenario: A small source batch is dated in the future.
resolution_summary: Reject future-dated records and review source date mapping.

business_impact: Known scenario: Measurement records are extracted before approval/close.
resolution_summary: Filter reporting to approved/closed records and check close workflow.

business_impact: Known scenario: Corrected measurement volume materially differs from raw aggregate.
resolution_summary: Compare raw aggregate to measured and corrected volume by meter/date.

business_impact: Known scenario: Publisher step has rejected records and partial success status.
root_cause_category: Target load rejected a subset of records
resolution_summary: Review publisher error rows, rejected count, and target acceptance rules.

business_impact: Known scenario: Source facility assignment conflicts with meter_master.
resolution_summary: Validate meter-to-facility mapping and effective dates.

business_impact: Known scenario: Source feed contains quality codes outside accepted values.
resolution_summary: Review accepted values and source code translation table.

business_impact: Known scenario: Inactive meters continue to produce readings.
resolution_summary: Confirm meter status and effective dates before including in reports.

business_impact: Known scenario: A small set of active meters sends null volumes.
resolution_summary: Check source payload and apply null-volume exception handling.

business_impact: Known scenario: A small number of impossible negative values appear in raw readings.
resolution_summary: Reject negative values and review source calculation.

business_impact: Known scenario: Actual measured volume materially differs from nominated volume.
resolution_summary: Compare actual vs nominated by facility/date/product and review exception impact.
